description: The EROS (Earth Remote Observation Satellite) B satellite is a high-resolution commercial Earth observation spacecraft equipped with a panchromatic CCD imager covering visible and near-infrared wavelengths (500-900 nm).
facility_description: The EROS satellite constellation was developed by Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) and is operated commercially by ImageSat International (ISI).
notes: EROS/EROS catalogs the commercial Earth observation satellite EROS-B panchromatic response curve published by imagery reseller Apollo Mapping. Terms are reserved under Apollo Mapping copyright.
